name: Mitsugetsu no Chou ~Boku, Maid Hajimemashita~
original_name: 蜜月の蝶～ぼく、メイドはじめました～
source:
"Your parents sold you, huh."

The beautiful sisters eyed me with a mixture of mischief and disdain. It was an extravagant huge house.

They gave me a red collar and a black collar.

From that night, and for every night, I was to wear a collar
and do the bidding of the older or younger sister.

However you call it, I was a toy to them.

"You're the maid now, you have to do what we say."

I had nowhere else to go. A prisoner enveloped in the lovely scent of these two butterflies.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE128219.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“你的父母把你卖了，对吧。”

美丽的姐妹带着恶作剧般的轻蔑打量我。那是一座奢华巨大的房子。

她们给我戴上红色项圈和黑色项圈。

从那晚开始，每晚我都必须戴着项圈，听从姐姐或妹妹的命令。

无论怎么称呼，我都只是她们的玩具。

“你现在是女仆了，必须听我们的。”

我无处可去，只能成为被这两只蝴蝶迷人香气包围的囚徒。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE128219.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
